prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A cinematic scene set inside a brightly lit, modern bakery or café with vivid red walls adorned with colorful food posters. The composition centers on two men standing side by side near a glass display case filled with pastries, their expressions serious and contemplative. The man on the left wears glasses and a short-sleeved blue button-up shirt tucked into beige pants, hands in his pockets, while the man beside him sports a dark t-shirt and jeans, his posture relaxed but attentive. In the foreground, a third figure is partially out of focus, creating a sense of depth and drawing the viewer’s eye toward the central subjects. The background features shelves stocked with bottled drinks, a glowing "OPEN" sign, and a staff member behind the counter, all bathed in the warm, slightly diffuse glow of overhead pendant lights. The color palette is dominated by rich reds, muted blues, and soft yellows, with a subtle teal tint that gives the image a moody, cinematic quality. The camera angle is at eye level, with a shallow depth of field that blurs the foreground and background, emphasizing the emotional weight and realism of the moment. The overall style evokes a contemplative, slice-of-life atmosphere, reminiscent of independent film or modern urban photography.
